meta.title: Update rosetta artifacts for 100-prisoners
meta.body_summary: Speed up the VM's now() builtin by using a PRNG from math/rand instead of system calls, and update Rosetta benchmark artifacts for the 100-prisoners example.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, the now() builtin is changed to use a PRNG from math/rand instead of system calls, seeded with MOCHI_NOW_SEED. Updated Rosetta benchmark artifact files for the 100-prisoners example to reflect changes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Benchmark and output files updated to match new IR; ROSETTA.md progress checklist refreshed.
